teamAnalysis: Compliance and origin remain primary drivers of landed cost, overshadowing spot prices. EU buyers face tightening EUDR (with deadlines holding firm despite IT system challenges), CBAM (with Q3 2026 certificate price now EUR 82.32 per tonne, and Q4 price due January 4, 2027), and the application of PPWR PFAS limits from August 12, 2026. US and Canadian costs are shaped by tariff stacks and country-of-origin/melt rules, with Section 301 exclusions extended to January 9, 2027, but a new 12.5% forced-labor tariff in effect for Chinese goods, and Canada's surtaxes on US-origin steel remaining at 50% with an extended remission program. Ocean freight trends are now falling, with Transpacific and Asia-Europe rates decreasing. Brent crude is now around $96.13/bbl, with persistent Strait of Hormuz concerns keeping energy-linked input costs volatile despite some easing oil prices, while polypropylene resin prices are showing regional increases. These market dynamics reinforce the importance of securing supply, capacity, and robust documentation early. Birdland's two-country production model, proactive freight booking, strategic material locking, and comprehensive compliance paperwork ensure stable supply and protect your margins amidst ongoing volatility.

advice.zh: 【Birdland 供應鏈週報】本週亞洲—美西運價下跌 (洛杉磯跌 2% 至 $7,416/FEU, 紐約跌 3% 至 $9,020/FEU), 亞洲—歐洲海運運價下跌 (鹿特丹跌 3% 至 $3,504/FEU, 熱那亞持平於 $4,168/FEU)。 北美鋼價受關稅支撐穩定偏漲,全球趨勢分歧,中國鋼廠減產護價; 木材價格相對穩定,塑膠粒則顯示區域性上漲趨勢。 Brent原油因荷姆茲海峽局勢持續緊張，油價維持在 $96.13 美元/桶左右。 建議:海運運價下跌,應戰略性訂艙,並分批鎖定鋼質料件與燃料相關投入。美方Section 301關稅排除措施已延長至2027年1月9日，但12.5%的強制勞動關稅已生效。加拿大對美國鋼鋁產品加徵關稅至50%,但其關稅減免計畫已延長並擴大範圍。 法規面 EUDR(2026/12/30)木柄文件請務必提早備齊,並留意PPWR(2026/8/12)對包裝PFAS的限制,該限制已生效。歐盟CBAM Q3憑證價格已公布為 EUR 82.32/噸。 需要我們協助規劃備料節奏與文件,隨時聯繫。
advice.en: [Birdland Supply-Chain Brief] Transpacific ocean freight rates are falling, with Shanghai to Los Angeles down 2% to $7,416/FEU and Shanghai to New York down 3% to $9,020/FEU. Asia–Europe rates are also falling, with Rotterdam down 3% to $3,504/FEU and Genoa flat at $4,168/FEU. North American steel prices are stable to slightly up, supported by tariffs, while global trends are mixed with China mills cutting production to defend prices; lumber prices are relatively stable, and resin is showing regional increases. Brent crude is now around $96.13/bbl on November 15, 2026, with persistent Strait of Hormuz concerns keeping oil prices elevated. We suggest strategically booking ocean space given the falling freight trends, and phasing in steel-input and fuel-linked cover. US Section 301 tariff exclusions have been extended to January 9, 2027, but a new 12.5% forced-labor tariff is in effect for Chinese goods. Canada's surtaxes on US-origin steel and aluminum remain at 50%, though its tariff remission program has been extended and expanded. On compliance, prepare EUDR (30 Dec 2026) timber documentation early and thoroughly, and note PPWR (12 Aug 2026) PFAS limits for packaging, which are now in effect. The EU CBAM Q3 certificate price was published on October 5, 2026, at EUR 82.32 per tonne. Contact us to plan your buying cadence and paperwork.
